name: my-prs
description: Shows the current branch's PR, its CI and review status in a band above the prompt

previewUrl.title: Preview URL
previewUrl.description: Template for a PR's preview deploy; {number} becomes the PR number, e.g. https://pr-{number}.preview.example.com. Empty: no preview link.

previewRepo.title: Preview repo
previewRepo.description: owner/repo whose PRs get the preview link. Empty: every repo.
